article.title: What I’ve been reading
article.excerpt: 1. Why Photography Matters as Art as Never Before , by Michael Fried. The text is weak (and mostly skippable), but still this had high value for me. It's a look at how photography has become the centerpiece of contemporary art, starting with Jeff Wall and offering well-chosen color images from the leading creators. I had been needing a book like this. 2.
